name: Sangita Das/ ସଂଗୀତା ଦାସ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sangita Das’s Odia poem ‘କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଝିଅ’, in Kabita Live’s May 2024 issue, portrays a woman whose imaginative life continues through everyday household activity. Stars become midnight visitors, the sky becomes a sari, and cooking, flowers and a shaft of light become occasions for the making of poetry.

The recurring image of the girl who writes poems holds together a more difficult contrast: admiration in public and reproach at home. The poem follows her attachment to words, her response to injustice and her resistance to a prescribed life, ending with the insistence that she lives on her own terms.
